'''Palak-Ti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] who broke out of the [[Belsavis prison]] during a break around [[3641 BBY]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Rattataki Battlewoods]] sometime after breaking out.

==Behind the scenes==
Palak-Ti appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on the planet Belsavis. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed by characters of both factions or loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
